free_tier.stated: 512 MB plan at USD 4.62/month billed USD 27.75 semi-annually: 1 vCPU, 512 MB RAM, 15 GB NVMe, 5 TB transfer, 1.5 Gbps port, IPv4 + IPv6. The page lists six locations across the United States and Europe (Liberty Lake WA, Kansas City MO, Valley Forge PA, Amsterdam NL, Sofia BG, Stockholm SE) without pairing cities to individual plans. It is sold out: the page states "Stock last updated: October 20th, 2026 - More stock soon." and every plan block reads "Out of stock in all locations"; the next size up, 1 GB at USD 7.60/month (USD 22.80 quarterly, 1 vCPU, 20 GB NVMe, 6 TB, 1.5 Gbps), carries the same line.

egress.terms: 5 TB a month on the 512 MB plan, 6 TB on the 1 GB plan, rising with the plan; no overage price published on the page read
egress.free_allowance: 5 TB per month on the 512 MB plan

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.tooling: KVM with root and NVMe storage, six POPs across the US and Europe, sold through the vendor's own site; no API documented on the page read. The vendor's description states the service is sold with "no personal information required" and accepts cryptocurrency payments, which is a claim about registration that evaluated providers did not verify against a signup form.
record.chaining: A 1.5 Gbps port and 5 TB a month on three European POPs makes this the best-shaped egress box among evaluated providers after Hosting Int., and 512 MB with 15 GB of NVMe runs a tunnel or a DNS node; the plan cannot be ordered today, and the 1 GB at USD 7.60 is the nearest thing to a substitute inside the same provider.

limits.value: 5 TB a month on a 1.5 Gbps port is 170 GB a day, 17 percent of the 1 TB daily transfer ceiling; the binding constraint today is stock rather than bytes, since the plan is out of stock in every location.

record.notes: The provider is not dead and the plan is not withdrawn, so no dead verdict: the page says out of stock with a restock promise, which is availability and not discontinuation. The tracker and the vendor disagree by USD 0.12 on the same plan (USD 4.50 against USD 4.62), which is the difference between a rounded month and a semi-annual divided by six; the vendor figure is recorded. verification criteria: a re-read to catch the restock, and a read of the signup page to test the no-personal-information claim.
